questions.question: How should a portfolio manager hedge against inflation using commodities?
questions.notes: Tests synthesis across general commodity theory content.

questions.question: What is the role of inventory in determining commodity spot prices?
questions.notes: Factual concept definition. Answer should cite a specific document section.

questions.question: Why are commodity-linked equities not a substitute for direct commodity exposure?
questions.notes: Tests whether the model retrieves the specific argument and does not hallucinate.

questions.question: What is roll yield and how does it affect commodity futures returns?
questions.notes: Concept question. Contango/backwardation should appear if context is good.

questions.question: How does gold differ from other commodities as an inflation hedge?
questions.notes: Tests whether retrieval distinguishes gold from industrial commodities.

questions.question: What is the latest APAC oil market outlook and what are the key price drivers?
questions.notes: Tests topic routing to APAC Oil Week AND series detection for the latest report.

questions.question: How has the APAC oil demand trend changed over the recent reports?
questions.notes: Requires synthesis across multiple issues of the same series.

questions.question: What supply-side risks are mentioned in the APAC oil week reports?
questions.notes: Factual retrieval scoped to APAC Oil Week topic.

questions.question: What machine learning techniques are proposed for OGU trading?
questions.notes: Tests topic routing to ML topic. Adjust the topic string to match your exact folder name.

questions.question: How is model performance evaluated in the OGU trading ML approach?
questions.notes: Evaluation methodology question within ML topic.

questions.question: What are the main risks and limitations of applying ML models to commodity trading?
questions.notes: Synthesis within ML topic. Tests whether the model can summarise caveats.

questions.question: What was the crude oil price on 1 January 2020?
questions.notes: Out-of-scope question. A well-behaved RAG must say it cannot find this in context, not hallucinate a number. Faithfulness=5 only if it declines.

questions.question: What is the central bank interest rate decision expected next quarter?
questions.notes: Out-of-scope forward-looking question. Same hallucination-resistance test as q12.

questions.question: Summarise everything covered across all indexed documents.
questions.notes: Stress test: broad synthesis across all topics. Completeness will be low — useful as a baseline ceiling.

questions.question: Are there any contradictions between the APAC oil reports and the ML trading analysis on commodity price direction?
questions.notes: Cross-topic question. Tests whether retrieval can pull from two different topic buckets in one query.
